answer: Run a recurring pseudonym party. Each month everyone is shuffled into small rooms at one hour, and a pass goes only to someone the others see live, one per person because nobody sits in two rooms at once. A pass dims like an ember unless renewed at the next party. A farm cannot forge a crowd of faces, so each fake needs a hired human's hour, and random seating, which finds its way like water through karst, scatters recruits so they cannot vouch for each other.
